build_aria_fisheye_camera: build a python module to create an ARIA fisheye624 camera calibration using get_aria_camera with custom params and resolution
project_3d_to_2d: create a function that projects 3D points into 2D pixel coordinates using CameraTW.project and returns validity masks
unproject_2d_to_3d_rays: create a function that unprojects 2D pixel coordinates into normalized 3D rays using CameraTW.unproject
scale_camera_parameters: build a python module to scale camera intrinsic parameters to a new image size using CameraTW.scale_to_size
resize_images_to_camera: create a function that resizes a batch of images to match CameraTW dimensions using scale_image_to_cam with bilinear interpolation
